{{Otheruses|Helix}}
A '''Floppy Helix Intensifier''' was a device that weakened the strength of a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] but produced a flat, winding arc a thousand times longer than the original beam. The [[Novaldex/Legends|Novaldex]] [[G47 Tractor Beam Generator]] used to keep [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] afloat were modified with Floppy Helix Intensifiers.
